evidence.title: 格通智联完成数亿元Pre A轮融资
evidence.subject: 格通智联
evidence.sourceExcerpt:
格通智联技术（上海）有限公司（“格通智联”），是一家以算力生态深度共建者为使命，致力于研发兼具高带宽、低时延、高可靠性的高速互联核心芯片与网络解决方案的公司。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）8月25日消息，格通智联近日 完成数亿元Pre A轮融资，本轮融资由张江高科领投，壁仞科技、国开科创、新鼎资本、联想创投、尚融资本等知名产业方与投资机构跟投。
Pre A轮所募集的资金将主要用于公司Scale-up南向互联芯片GT-Link与南向交换芯片GT-Fabric的研发生产、G-Link开放互联标准的生态推广，加速格通智联在国产算力南向互联赛道的布局，推动国产算力集群互联互通发展进入快车道。
张江高科表示： “格通智联是其重点布局的算力互联技术企业，自主研发的GT-Link、GT-Fabric系列高速互联/交换芯片，是推动Scale-up高速互联方案本土化落地的典型案例。目前，张江高科正构建集成电路全产业链协同创新生态，通过打造895孵化器、产业基金、公共技术平台等，为格通智联等算力企业提供从技术验证、测试到应用场景对接的全周期服务。未来，张江高科将进一步聚焦算力互联、异构集成等赛道，强化区域协同与资本赋能，持续巩固张江在AI算力基础设施核心部件领域的集群优势。”

evidence.title: 「帷幄」完成4000万美元 C3 轮融资，打造全球企业级AI 平台
evidence.subject: 帷幄
evidence.sourceExcerpt:
投资界（ID：pedaily2012）7月15日消息，全球化企业级 AI 厂商帷幄今日正式宣布 完成4000 万美元 C3 轮融资 。至此，帷幄C 轮累计融资总额突破 1 亿美元。
本轮C3 融资由 招银国际(CMB International, CMBI) 旗下专注于 AI 及前沿科技的基金、日本三井住友银行 (Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, SMBC) 旗下企业风险投资基金 SARF (SMBC Asia Rising Fund)、三菱 UFG (MUFG) 旗下泰国大城银行 (Bank of Ayudhya) 企业创投 (CVC) 平台 Krungsri Finnovate、弘章投资 (Charisma Partners) 以及韩国现代汽车集团 (Hyundai Motor Group) 联合出资，新加坡电信 （Singtel Innov8) 追加投资 。
C 轮其他战略投资方包括博世创投 (Bosch Ventures)、MTR Lab、印尼电信 (MDI Ventures)、Gentree Fund 以及线性资本 (Linear Capital)。
帷幄本轮融资资金将重点投入三大方向：持续迭代BWM 底层核心技术，强化「感知 — 认知 — 执行」全链路能力；联合全球产业伙伴共建跨行业标准化智能解决方案，推动平台能力在多元场景中规模化复制；完善海外区域总部与本地化服务体系，为出海企业提供适配区域市场需求的落地支撑。
帷幄是全球化的企业级AI 原生科技公司，以自研商业世界模型 (Business World Model, BWM) 为核心技术底座，为线上线下全渠道经营主体提供感知、认知、执行全链路平台级 AI 能力。

2026年3月，讯兔科技（Alpha派）正式完成近2亿元A轮融资。继去年10月完成超亿元Pre-A轮融资后，讯兔科技在短短5个月内再获顶级机构强强加持。本轮资本阵容呈现为“一线顶流VC+战略型产业资本+老股东持续加注”格局：启明创投、红杉中国、高瓴创投共同领投，广发乾和、信宸资本（中信资本旗下私募 股权投资 业务）、清科控股跟投并赋能产业协同，老股东钟鼎资本和嘉程资本持续追加。华兴资本担任公司独家财务顾问。
集结了头部VC和产业投资方的多元资本阵容，不仅印证了讯兔科技在金融AI赛道的稀缺价值，更为公司注入了内生增长与生态外延的双重动能。

evidence.title: 8400亿，史上最大融资来了
evidence.subject: OpenAI
evidence.sourceExcerpt:
刚刚，OpenAI完成创纪录融资——
融资金额1220亿美元 （约合8411.54亿人民币）， 投后估值8520亿美元 （约合5.9万亿人民币）。
此次，OpenAI还首次通过银行渠道向投资者开放了参与机会，从个人投资者手中筹集了超过30亿美元。
本轮融资过后，市场对OpenAI的IPO期待值，越来越高了。
OpenAI史上最大融资纪录来了
本次融资的投资方包括亚马逊、英伟达、软银等机构联合领投。
其中英伟达和软银的各自押注300亿美元，亚马逊则以500亿美元进行出资。
与此同时，OpenAI的长期合作伙伴Microsoft也出现在投资方名单中。
虽然官方新闻稿并未披露其此次具体出资额，但截至去年年底，Microsoft已累计向OpenAI投入超过130亿美元，关系之深也似乎不言自明了。
此外相较于此前几轮的融资，这次融资还有亿点点新变动，那就是OpenAI第一次向个人投资者开放窗口，额外吸纳了超过30亿美元资金。
在某种程度也反映出OpenAI在资本形态上开始从少数巨头资本主导转向了更广泛的综合型融资结构，资本来源也变得更分散化了。
夸张的估值之下，不少网友认为，“这是对 Scaling Laws 没有上限的一次豪赌”。
而奥特曼也面临证明巨额估值合理性的更大压力——最近，OpenAI已经砍掉了包括Sora在内的不少功能和产品，以收拢算力、控制成本。
从OpenAI的官方公告来看，他们的底气是：
OpenAI是最快达到1000万用户的技术平台，也是最快达到1亿用户的平台，并且很快将成为最快达到10亿周活跃用户的平台。
官方表示，在推出ChatGPT一年内，OpenAI的收入达到了10亿美元。在2024年底，其每季度收入达到10亿美元。
现在，OpenAI的收入则已达 20亿美元/月 。
我们的收入增长速度是Alphabet（Google母公司）和Meta等定义了互联网和移动互联网时代的公司的4倍。
OpenAI去年的收入为131亿美元。不过，目前尚未实现盈利。
另外，在公告中OpenAI还透露， 其广告试点项目在六周时间内， ARR 就超过了1亿美元 。
目前，ToB收入已占到OpenAI收入的40%以上，有望在2026年与 ToC 收入持平。
而接下来，OpenAI还将聚焦打造“AI超级应用”

evidence.subject: Google DeepMind
evidence.sourceExcerpt: AI weather models have spent three years closing the gap with physics-based forecasting, but two problems stayed open: resolution too coarse for local terrain, and initialization tied to numerical weather prediction (NWP) analysis that arrives about six hours late. WeatherNext 3 , released by Google DeepMind and Google Research, attacks both. It takes a live global geostationary satellite mosaic as a direct model input, re-initializes every hour, and emits forecasts down to 0.05° (~5 km) while training against raw weather station measurements rather than reanalysis grids alone. According to Google AI, independent live evaluations from Brightband rank it as the most accurate global weather model to date.

evidence.title: Google 发布 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe：85+ 语言平均 WER 2.6% 的语音转文本模型
evidence.subject: Google
evidence.sourceExcerpt: Google has released Gemini 3.5 Transcribe , a speech-to-text model for real-time voice interfaces and recorded audio. It ships as two endpoints, not one. gemini-3.5-transcribe handles pre-recorded files through the Interactions API . gemini-3.5-transcribe-live handles bidirectional streaming through the Live API . Google reports average word error rates of 4.0% streaming and 2.6% non-streaming, as measured by Artificial Analysis. Time to final transcription improves 70% over Chirp 3, the previous model. Automatic detection covers more than 85 languages, including mid-sentence code-switching. The split between the two endpoints is the part worth planning around. They do not share the same feature set, limits, or price.

evidence.title: Harvey 推出基于 Kimi K3 的后训练模型 Harvey Tenet
evidence.subject: Harvey
evidence.sourceExcerpt: Harvey has released Harvey Tenet , its first post-trained model, as a research preview as of today. Tenet is a Kimi K3 base post-trained with Fireworks through asynchronous reinforcement learning on long-horizon legal work. The training corpus combined synthetic data, publicly available legal data, and human expert data. Harvey states no customer data was used. Against the base K3 model, Tenet completes almost twice as many held-out tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB) and 20% more on LAB: Contracts , raising all-pass rate by 9 and 2 percentage points respectively. Harvey reports state-of-the-art on LAB: Contracts and second place on LAB. The gains also transferred, untrained, to Mercor’s APEX Agents and Crosby’s Redline Bench . The stated goal is twofold: build frontier legal intelligence on open-weight models, and give law firms a path to own their own specialized models.

evidence.title: DiffusionGemma 技术报告：Google DeepMind 开源离散扩散模型，单卡 H100 每秒生成约 1500 token
evidence.sourceName: Hacker News 热门（buzzing.cc 中文翻译）
evidence.subject: Google DeepMind
evidence.sourceExcerpt: Abstract: We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed. Rather than decoding one token at a time, DiffusionGemma iteratively refines blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, avoiding the sequential decoding bottleneck of conventional autoregressive (AR) large language models. Instead of training from scratch, we obtain DiffusionGemma by fine-tuning the mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with 3.8B activated and 25.2B total parameters. Our compute-efficient two-stage training pipeline uses fewer than 10% of the starting AR model's total training token budget. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to teach bidirectional denoising, while the second stage combines reinforcement learning with sampler distillation to jointly improve generation quality and inference efficiency. DiffusionGemma establishes a new Pareto frontier for the trade-off between generation speed and model capability. Averaged across our full evaluation suite, it generates around 20 tokens per forward pass and achieves roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, which is substantially faster than AR models even with state-of-the-art speculative decoding. DiffusionGemma also retains the starting model's support for thinking mode, multimodal inputs, and long contexts. Despite diffusion fine-tuning, it remains capable of AR generation with only minor performance degradation, suggesting a path toward hybrid diffusion-AR decoding.

evidence.title: 开源模型生态的未来：Nvidia 押注"教所有人炼 token"
evidence.subject: NVIDIA
evidence.sourceExcerpt: Housekeeping: No voiceover for this post as I’m traveling. The oldest comparison people try to make is how what’s happening with open models compares to foundational open-source software projects like the Linux operating system. There are fairly clean analogies, but they paint a narrow path forwards for the self-sustaining nature of the open-source model ecosystem, where once Linux got big enough it was going to be self-fulfilling as the best possible tool for many jobs. The open-source language model – i.e. only models that come with a full training recipe, data, code, etc. – is a closer analogue to the open-source operating system. The open weight models you use – those with just model weights and inference code to run them – are closer to specific versions of software that you install in a project built upon them.
